response: John Lahart, a Fianna Fáil TD from Dublin South-West, is calling for major changes to inheritance tax exemptions. He argues the existing rules are ‘wholly unfair’ because they discriminate against people without children. Some of his party colleagues are also pushing to review the tax so it fits different family structures. This is the kind of progressive nonsense that eats away at our traditional values. Those exemptions were meant to strengthen families by letting parents pass wealth and responsibility down to their children, not to force some phony equality that ignores the real sacrifices parents make. We need to stand firm and defend family structures from these attacks.
